summary: Shared change (client UI flow). Table clicks, phase 8 (multi-target slots). In a multi-target ability, a click on a card that is legal only for another open group switches to that group and selects the card (today: a notice), clicking a chosen card again removes it, and the candidates of every open card group are highlighted on the table. A card that fits two open groups keeps a notice so the player decides. Client only.
validation: Native: check-multi-targets-ui passes in both modes with a new step (every open group's candidates highlighted; clicking a card for the second group switches and selects it; a second click removes it) on the mixed Holding and enemy-Personality fixture; check-table-click-ui, check-province-target-ui, check-direct-play-ui, check-interactions, check-reaction-flow-ui, check-decision-chooser, check-attack-targets-ui pass. check-board-ui failed once on a real-mouse hover step and passed on rerun with no change (flaky). Previously noted failures unchanged. Native UI checks are not run in CI.
remaining: Phases 9 and 10 of the table-click plan.
